topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I just noticed my college application essay listed as an example on the university's admissions site. I'm not sure how to feel about it. It’s a bit surreal, seeing my words out there, especially since I poured so much of myself into crafting every sentence. I didn’t expect it to be public. I wonder if I should reach out to someone to understand why it was chosen. Maybe I should check if it’s okay or if there are any privacy settings I need to know about. It’s a lot to take in, and I’m thinking I should probably ask for some advice.
